summary: Took apart two fast-growing 3D explainer channels (3D Eye, You Built A...) and added one Shorts topic (why the school answer for how planes fly is wrong), a trial story shape and one challenger for the weekly loop.
why: 3D Eye's airplane Short has 3.49M views in 13 days (21.7x its channel); You Built A...'s small-to-giant Shorts reach 2.53M on 12K subscribers. Our own Shorts have too few views (45-255) for the evaluator to rank anything yet.

findings.title: A myth fixed with a 3D picture pulls millions
findings.detail: 3D Eye's 'What Makes an Airplane Fly' adds 270K views a day; NASA Glenn says the common school answer for lift is wrong. Added as tonight's topic with Airbus A380 figures.

findings.title: One repeatable shape: a small thing becomes a giant one
findings.detail: You Built A... (12K subscribers) runs every video this way; bricks to skyscraper has 2.53M (211x). Added as a trial shape and a challenger.

findings.title: '3D Animation' in a title makes no difference
findings.detail: Across 1,955 recent niche Shorts: 0.94x the channel median with '3D' in the title, 1.00x without. Not proposed.

changes.title: 1 topic added
changes.detail: 2026-11-22-how-wings-lift (score 10.16, second in the feed), 4 Airbus facts.
